source_attribution: agent_callable_tier corrected from 'full-api' to 'human-checkout' on 2026-09-16T02:22:37Z. The tier means "you complete the purchase end to end programmatically" (SKILL.md), and this record does not support that: its own description states Bitcoin is accepted via account balance top-up, so the crypto rail requires a human to fund the account before the API can spend it, and agent_endpoints carries only api_docs and auth_note, which are documentation rather than a connection surface. The ordering API is real; what an agent cannot do unaided is pay. LIMIT: namecheap.com's own Bitcoin payment page could not be read to confirm the funding mechanism, as it answers a Cloudflare interstitial to a scripted request, so this correction rests on the record's own text plus the absence of any recorded crypto payment endpoint, not on the merchant's page.
